name: LitmusChaos
description: CNCF sandbox Kubernetes-native chaos engineering platform that defines experiments as native Kubernetes resources, with a rich ChaosHub of community experiments and optional web UI (LitmusPortal).
reputation: Popular open-source choice among cloud-native SRE teams and a key CNCF chaos engineering project.
notes: Tight Kubernetes integration; developer-centric with version-controlled experiments but requires cluster access.
